\par\smallskip\footnotesize
Contract amm-tools/3 (17 tools; profile B 14, profile C 17); results carry the outcome schema amm-outcome/1. Source: \texttt{results/software/contract\_amm-tools-3.json} (written by \texttt{scripts/software/write\_contract.py}).\par
Outcomes: Certified candidate (\texttt{certified\_candidate}); Information needed (\texttt{need\_info}); Not found in families (\texttt{not\_found\_in\_families}); Numerically undetermined (\texttt{numerically\_undetermined}); Proven infeasible (\texttt{proven\_infeasible}); Refuted candidate (\texttt{refuted\_candidate}). Five are physical outcomes; \texttt{need\_info} stops the session and asks.\par
Refusal rule (profile C; not applied in ablation profile B): NOT\_FOUND\_IN\_FAMILIES needs one of atlas\_not\_found, search\_not\_found; OTHER needs one of bound\_violation, atlas\_not\_found, search\_not\_found, certificate\_undetermined, certificate\_refuted; PROVEN\_INFEASIBLE needs one of bound\_violation; UNDETERMINED needs one of certificate\_undetermined.\par
Interfaces: every tool is called through \texttt{amm.tools.Session.call} (Python library); the MCP server (\texttt{amm/mcp\_server.py}) registers the tools of the session's profile; the browser GUI backend (\texttt{app/}) calls the same Session; the command line (\texttt{amm/cli.py}, added in V2) passes its arguments unchanged to \texttt{Session.call}. Interface acceptance through library, MCP, GUI and CLI: table T12 (V2).\par
'Changes spec' = the tool mutates the session's specification (logged and replayable).\par
Added in schema 2: certify: outcome; evaluate: results C derived C\_MPa; get\_session: schema\_version evidence budget.as\_built budget\_used.as\_built; submit: outcome\_card submitted.outcome submitted.evidence.\par
Added in schema 3: evaluate: args bands, results bands.\par
